decisions.reason: As the current analytics standard and a close fit with the firm's shop-technology and measurement positioning, the GA4 plugin is likely to retain backing and any weaker demand can still be framed as normal client-specific implementation timing.

Even with prior development effort, a Universal Analytics plugin is no longer strategically defensible in 2025 because the underlying platform is obsolete and poor prospects cannot credibly be explained as temporary.

The retail system interface plugin supports the firm's full-service integration promise, so management is inclined to persist with it and justify patience by pointing to longer merchant adoption and customization cycles.

Because the relaunch SEO support service was publicly presented as part of the firm's offering and is central to its stated performance-oriented service mix, management is likely to continue it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

The SEO workshops are a recent, visibly marketed service that complements the firm's consulting capabilities, so management will likely keep them and attribute any limited traction to ramp-up and client budgeting cycles rather than to a bad concept.
